name: Stoeph Streckeisen
bio:
Stoeph Streckeisen, based in Malters, Lucerne, Switzerland, is a maestro in tribal tattoo stiles. With an artistic career dating back to 2005, Stoeph specializes in Polynesian and Celtic-inspired ink at the renowned Streckeisen & Feller Tattoo Studio. Known for their unwavering professionalism, they ensure each client leaves with a meticulously crafted piece of art and a truly outstanding tattoo experience.
Price: $
Current location: Malters, Lucerne, Switzerland

Leidenschaftlicher Tätowierer seit 2005.    Polynesisch inspirierte Tattoos im Kanton Luzern.
